about_the_game:
Step into the dusty boots of a Wild West sheriff where logic is your weapon, time is your enemy, and outlaws are everywhere.


In Sort West, you're not just solving puzzles — you're cleaning up the frontier. Organize colorful balls to complete challenges, outsmart rising difficulty, and capture the most dangerous criminals in the West. Every level cleared brings you closer to justice, but take too long... and you might just catch a bullet instead.


Key Features:
  • Unique Wild West twist on classic color-sorting puzzles
  • Capture outlaws by completing increasingly tricky levels
  • Survive for years as sheriff while the pressure grows
  • Sheriff Timeline system records your legacy — success or failure
  • Stylized Western visuals and immersive desert atmosphere

Think fast. Shoot straight. And don’t let the West break you.

Add Sort West to your wishlist and prove you're the law around here!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel-compatible processor with 1.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card compatible with DirectX 9
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel-compatible processor with 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with support for OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card

short_description: Become the sheriff of the Wild West. Use your wits to solve puzzles, capture outlaws, and survive for years without taking a bullet. Your legend will be written with every criminal caught — or stained by every mistake.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
